AddDatabase.description_en: Use this API to connect databases on other clouds or on-premises to Alibaba Cloud
AddDatabase.description_zh: 调用此API可以将他云或本地的数据库接入至阿里云

AddDatabaseList.description_en: Adds multiple databases to a gateway in a batch operation
AddDatabaseList.description_zh: 调用此API可以在网关中批量添加数据库

CheckDGEnabled.description_en: Checks if Database Gateway (DG) is enabled
CheckDGEnabled.description_zh: 调用此API可以检查当前用户是否开通数据库网关产品

ConnectDatabase.description_en: Call this API to test database connectivity
ConnectDatabase.description_zh: 调用此API对数据库连通性进行测试

CreateGateway.description_zh: 调用此 API 创建一个全新的数据库网关

CreateGatewayVerifyCode.description_en: Generates a verification code to link an on-premises Database Gateway installation to its corresponding gateway in the cloud
CreateGatewayVerifyCode.description_zh: 调用此API可以生成线下安装网关时需要的验证码。该验证码将与云上创建的网关相对应

DeleteDatabase.description_en: Deletes a database from a database gateway
DeleteDatabase.description_zh: 调用此API可删除数据库网关中添加的数据库

DeleteGateway.description_zh: 调用此API可以删除指定网关

DeleteGatewayInstance.description_en: Deletes the specified database gateway instance
DeleteGatewayInstance.description_zh: 调用此API可以删除指定的数据库网关节点

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions where you can create database gateways
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 调用此API可以获取支持创建数据库网关的地域

DownloadGatewayProgram.description_en: Retrieves the download URL for the gateway program. Any Alibaba Cloud user can call this operation without requiring permissions
DownloadGatewayProgram.description_zh: 调用此API可以获取网关程序的下载地址。阿里云用户均可下载，无需权限认证

FindUserGatewayById.description_en: Retrieves the details of a gateway, including the user who created it and the number of running gateway instances
FindUserGatewayById.description_zh: 调用此API可以获取网关的详细信息，包括网关的创建人、运行中的网关节点数量等信息

GetUserDatabases.description_en: This API lists the databases in a specified gateway
GetUserDatabases.description_zh: 调用此API可以查看指定网关中已添加的数据库列表信息

GetUserGatewayInstances.description_en: Call this API to get the details of the gateway node
GetUserGatewayInstances.description_zh: 调用此API可以获取网关节点的详细信息

GetUserGateways.description_en: Retrieves a list of user-created Database Gateways
GetUserGateways.description_zh: 调用此API可以获取用户创建的DG网关列表

ListDatabaseAccessPoint.description_en: Gets a list of database access points
ListDatabaseAccessPoint.description_zh: 调用此API可以获取数据库访问点列表

ModifyDatabase.description_en: This operation modifies database information, such as its description
ModifyDatabase.description_zh: 调用此API可以修改数据库描述等信息

ModifyGateway.description_en: Call this API to modify the basic information of a gateway, including the gateway name and gateway description
ModifyGateway.description_zh: 调用该API可以修改网关的基本信息，包含网关名称和网关描述

RetryDatabase.description_en: Call this API operation to reconnect a database gateway to a database
RetryDatabase.description_zh: 调用此API可以使数据库网关重新连接数据库

StopGateway.description_zh: 调用此API可以停止网关服务
